Basis of Presentation The interim Consolidated Financial Statements of Howmet Aerospace Inc. and its subsidiaries (“Howmet” or the “Company” or “we” or “our”) are unaudited. These Consolidated Financial Statements include all adjustments, consisting only of normal recurring adjustments, considered necessary by management to fairly state the Company’s results of operations, financial position, and cash flows. This Form 10-Q report should be read in conjunction with the Company's Annual Report on Form 10-K for the year ended December 31, 2025 (the “Form 10-K”), which includes all disclosures required by GAAP, and with Exhibit 99.1 to the Company’s Current Report on Form 8-K dated May 28, 2026, which provides recast historical segment information.
